units.source_text: “这孩子一看见艺妓，就提高尾音喊驹姐、驹姐的。

en.t: Whenever this child sees a geisha, she calls out in a rising voice, 'Koma, Koma.'

units.source_text: 无论是看照片还是图片，凡有梳日本发髻的，她就认为是‘驹姐’。

en.t: Whether it is a photograph or a picture, if the woman has her hair done in the Japanese style, she thinks it is 'Koma.'

units.source_text: 我很喜欢孩子，因此很懂得孩子的心理，我说：‘小君，到驹子姐家里去玩好吗？’”

en.t: I am very fond of children, so I understand how children think, and I said, 'Kimi, shall we go play at Komako's house?'
